name: ERCC excision repair 3, TFIIH core complex helicase subunit

function.text: ERCC3 encodes general transcription and DNA repair factor IIH helicase/translocase subunit XPB. Annotated molecular activities include ATP hydrolysis activity and 3'-5' DNA helicase activity. It participates in DNA repair and transcription-coupled nucleotide-excision repair.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include xeroderma pigmentosum group B (autosomal recessive); trichothiodystrophy 2, photosensitive (autosomal recessive). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Melanoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
